howto.goal: Score more points than the other side: your stones plus empty points only you surround. Dark gets 7.5 points.
howto.setup: A 9 by 9 board. Light moves first and passes are allowed; dark gets 7.5 points.

sections.title: Placing
sections.text: Click an empty point to place a stone. Stones are captured when they have no empty neighbour left.

sections.title: Capturing
sections.text: Surround an enemy group completely and it comes off the board.

sections.title: Ending
sections.text: Two passes in a row end the game, and the side holding more points wins; dark's 7.5 points are added to its score.

controls: Click an empty point to place a stone.
Click Pass when you have nothing useful left.
The ringed point is where this lesson wants you.

frames.say: A surrounded stone is captured and removed.

demo.intro: A short computer game on 9 by 9, showing contact play and how a group's shape grows.
demo.outro: In Go, stones that stay connected stay alive. Spread out early, connect later.

steps.say: Click a central point for your first stone.
Keep your stones connected — a lone stone is easy to surround.
Surround a single enemy stone on all four sides to capture it.
Click Pass when you have no useful move left.
